description: Centralized probability and confidence thresholds for workflow decisions

skip_to_adversarial.description: Skip remaining evidence tiers if P(Architect) OR P(Pragmatist) exceeds this value
skip_to_adversarial.rationale: High probability indicates sufficient evidence to proceed to adversarial challenge

low_confidence_block.description: BLOCK checkpoint if final confidence below this value
low_confidence_block.rationale: Classifications below 50% confidence require human review

uncertainty_range.description: Flag as high uncertainty if probability falls within this range
uncertainty_range.rationale: Probabilities in 40-60% range indicate genuine uncertainty requiring careful analysis

early_termination.description: May terminate early if confidence exceeds this after Tier 1 with strong evidence
early_termination.rationale: Very high confidence with Tier 1 evidence may not need additional tiers

extreme_lr_flag.description: Flag for review if combined likelihood ratio exceeds these bounds
extreme_lr_flag.rationale: Extreme LRs suggest potential calculation error or extraordinary evidence

confidence_caps.description: Maximum confidence allowed based on highest quality evidence tier present

rationale.tier1: Even official sources can be outdated or misinterpreted
rationale.tier2: Industry sources require triangulation for high confidence
rationale.tier4: Pure inference without direct evidence has high uncertainty

temporal_thresholds.description: Evidence freshness boundaries aligned with Tetlock superforecasting research

rationale.current: Evidence less than 12 months old receives full weight (Tetlock-aligned)
rationale.historical: Evidence over 3 years old provides context only (0.3 weight)

calibration_targets.description: Targets for Brier score calibration tracking per methodology/calibration-tracking.md

rationale.warning: Approaching random chance (0.25 for binary predictions)
rationale.minimum: Fewer than 10 validations is insufficient for reliable calibration assessment

abandon_thresholds.description: Thresholds for triggering ABANDON gate decision

rationale.null_results: After 15 searches with no relevant evidence, consider abandoning
rationale.tiers: Must complete at least Tier 1 and Tier 2 before abandoning

probability_anchors.rationale: P(Architect) > 80% or P(Architect) < 20% indicates strong directional evidence

maturity_weights.description: Weights for calculating maturity score from claim types

usage_notes: All thresholds in this file should be referenced by agent prompts rather than hardcoded
Changes to thresholds here will propagate to all agents on next execution
Threshold changes should be logged in checkpoint-log.json with rationale
The 80% skip threshold is intentionally asymmetric - we're more cautious about ARCHITECT claims
